name: skill-router
description: Route requests to disabled Codex skills and manage installed skills based on usage. Reports last-used time per skill, suggests stale ones, and disables them by renaming SKILL.md files.

interface.shortDescription: Route and manage stale Codex skills
interface.longDescription: Skill Router routes long-tail requests to disabled Codex skills, audits installed skills, suggests unused or stale entries, and safely disables selected skills by renaming SKILL.md files so they can be restored later.
defaultPrompt: Route this request to a disabled skill
